title: Rule Requirements
titleTh: ข้อกำหนดของระเบียบ (Rule Requirements)
catShortTh: การกำกับดูแลความปลอดภัยสารสนเทศ

rows.req: ①Scope of application: all employees ②Definition of IT security: includes confidentiality, integrity, and availability

①Target person of IT Manager: organization, job title ②The duties of IT Manager: operation of systems and IT devices, maintaining IT security, response to incidents, failures ③Business use environment: prohibiting use of private environments for business use, restricting private use of company environments ④Inspection: Self-inspection of IT security establishment/operation, confirmation when introducing cloud services
①Training: regular information security training for employees, drills on targeted attack emails ②Security measures of offices, server rooms and data centers: entry/exit restrictions, locking

①Account management procedures: registration/modification/deletion, periodic inventorying, and restricting shared accounts ②Access permissions procedure: Initial setting according to affiliation and  job title, judgment of grant / change / deletion (including inventory)  ③Account authentication:password strength, two-factor authentication, password management

rows.cat: (5)IT asset management and Measures for terminals
rows.req: ①IT asset management: Ledger management of IT equipment, software, and service  ②Measures for terminals: user authentication, prevents unauthorized configuration changes and function modifications, conceals recorded electronic information ③Operation of terminals: approval when taking out company-owned PCs with containing confidential information and using external storage media, response in case of theft or loss
①Software/services used in business: Approval by IT manager, etc. ②Measures for virus/vulnerabirity: antivirus software installation / operation, security patches application

①Company networks management and control: configuration management, network segment separation, monitoring between internal/external boundaries ②Measures of remote access: restricts access source terminals and connection destinations、two-factor authentication、restricting the downloading ③Using the Internet: web filtering, follows the information asset management rules when sending confidential information

rows.cat: (8)Measures for business systems and communication tools
rows.req: ①Measures of business system: measures for security risks, configuration management、concealing confidential information,controling the removal of information ②communication tools (email, chat tools, web conference tools, etc.) used in business: Approval by IT manager, etc., consideration of communication content

①logs/backup: obtaining, storing, and monitoring ②When a security incident occurs: establishing response procedures, takeing preventive measuresafter ③When a disaster occurs: maintain system availability required to continue business

①Target person of Information Manager: organization, job title ②The duties of Information Manager: Guidance to employees under the control, access permissions management, designation of confidential information, response in case of information leakage  ③Inspection: Self-inspections of  information asset management ④Outsourcing of confidential information management to a third-party: confirmation of compliance with confidential information management policy, determining the management status

①Confidential information: information asset that must not be leaked to individuals other than specific parties or related parties. ②Strictly confidential information:information asset that could have a very serious impact on the company's management, business, or subjects of information (customers, etc.) in the event of a leak, etc. ③Strictly confidential information includes the following: ・Insider information ・Information related to misconduct and noncompliance Sensitive personal information of employees  External (customers’ or other) personal information ④Designation of confidential information / confidentiality classification: Information Manager defines considering legal regulations and contents of information assets, etc.

①Electronic information in general: store/save in high-security storage  ② Digital information classified as highly confidential: Managed separately from other information assets, and the Information Manager periodically provides confirmation and guidance on the storage and retention of confidential information ③How confidential information is stored/saved and provides guidance: Information Manager regularly confirms  to those under their supervision

①Restriction users with access to confidential information: those who need it for business ②Restriction users with access to strictly confidential information: extremely limited among employees ③When allowing individuals to access confidential information: approval is obtained from the Information Manager

① Handling confidential information in locations where there are many and unspecified people: Generally prohibited; if required for business, implement measures to prevent information leaks, and keep removed confidential information to the minimum required for business purposes after obtaining approval from the Information Manager.

① General information assets: Do not use or provide outside the company without due cause.  ②For electronic information, when shareing strictly confidential information inside/outside the company or shareing other confidential information outside the company: generally store/save information assets on high-security storage ③In cases where information assets concerning the acquisition/loss of rights and obligations such as contracts are to be received: confirming the signature of a legitimate responsible person

title: List of Password Requirements
titleTh: รายการข้อกำหนดรหัสผ่าน (Password Requirements)
catShortTh: การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

data.alt: Both ① and ② below must be satisfied ① Length: 8 characters or longer ② Multifactor authentication Must satisfy all of the following if the above cannot be satisfied A) Monitor whether lock settings are released B) Prohibit automatic release after a certain period of time passes following erroneous input lock (user application required) C) Check with relevant users at least once per month to determine whether lock was due to erroneous input by said user

data.req: Use at least three types of characters (uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols)
data.alt: In order to ensure that deciphering will take a sufficiently long time during a brute force attack, a password must have 15 or more characters if only letters are used or a combination of letters and numbers (passwords consisting of numbers only or symbols only are not allowed)

data.setting: Account locking after incorrect password entry
data.req: Lockout after 5 or fewer consecutive unsuccessful login attempts
Do not automatically unlock the account after a certain period of time (user must request this be done)

Educate users so they will not use the following character strings for their passwords ・Their user IDs, first and last names ・Repeating or sequential character strings ・Names of services or people, etc. ・Sequences of adjacent letters on the keyboard ・Characters contained in previously leaked passwords
Prohibit use of the character strings above in each system
Educate users so they will not reuse passwords
Specify the maximum number of generations that is manageable in each system
Administrator accounts: Ensure that passwords must be changed within 3 months
Automated by system (such as requiring periodic changing on password only for OS/DB accounts)
Hash passwords, or encrypt them if this is not possible

note: *Automatically display an error message when a password that does not meet the requirements is entered, etc.

title: Detective Scenario List
titleTh: รายการสถานการณ์การตรวจจับ (Detective Scenarios)
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

data.rule: Check network device’s destination IP data (logs) with malicious domains/IPs (threat data)

data.scenario: Executing files with malicious hash values
data.rule: Check PC operation logs and malicious hash value file information (threat information)
Check AD server, etc. authentication logs and malicious domain/IP (threat information)
Alert generated by antivirus or EDR installed on PCs

data.scenario: Heavy downloading, or uploading to external source from Box
data.src: Highly secure file storage, network device
data.siem: Either ① or ② is required ① Detected by SIEM, ② Detected by highly secure storage
data.rule: ・Check operation logs and data size information of highly secure file storage, PC operation logs, and network device logs, and detect data removal from highly secure storage ・Detect data removal exceeding a certain size (such as 10 MB or more) in network device logs

data.scenario: Statistically suspicious behavior compared to normal condition
data.siem: Either ① or ② is required ① Detected by SIEM, ② Detected by highly secure storage
data.rule: ・Detect large downloads from highly secure file storage operation logs, data size information, and applicable user information

data.scenario: Behavior that is statistically more suspicious than normal (high traffic at night and holidays, downloading more data than usual, etc.)
data.rule: Check statistical information in the communication logs combining with destination data

data.scenario: Granting of access permissions to an account that is highly likely to be for personal use (such as a free email address)
data.siem: Either ① or ② is required ① Detected by SIEM, ② Detected by highly secure storage
data.rule: Check highly secure file storage operation logs (logs from when permission was added) and free email address domain information
Define SIEM detection rules for when EDR is disabled on a PC
Detect administrator account creation operations (such as adding an account to an administrator group) from AD logs
